_comment: Personal dictionary. 'hotwords' bias Whisper toward your vocabulary so it hears names/jargon correctly. 'corrections' are a whole-word, case-insensitive find/replace safety net applied after transcription. Edit freely; restart the app to reload. NOTE (2026-09-07): 'ether' -> 'Aethyr' because the notebook is dictated that way; 'either' is deliberately NOT mapped, it is ordinary English. If you ever dictate about diethyl ether or the luminiferous ether, that word will come out 'Aethyr' - remove the entry if that ever costs more than it saves.
